content:
**Total area (including inland water) of the five permanent members of the United Nations Security Council (P5)**  

| Country | Area (km²) | Source |
|---------|------------|--------|
| **China** | **9,596,961 km²** | <https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/China#Geography> |
| **France** | **643,801 km²** (metropolitan France ≈ 551,695 km² + overseas regions) | <https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/France#Geography> |
| **Russia** | **17,098,242 km²** | <https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russia#Geography> |
| **United Kingdom** | **242,495 km²** (including overseas territories) | <https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Kingdom#Geography> |
| **United States** | **9,833,517 km²** (land + inland water) | <https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States#Geography> |

### How the figures are defined  

* **Land + inland water**: All of the numbers above include both land area and inland water bodies (lakes, rivers, reservoirs) as reported by the respective country’s statistical agencies and compiled on Wikipedia’s “Geography” pages.  
* **Overseas territories**: For France and the United Kingdom the totals incorporate their overseas departments/regions and territories, because the official “area of the state” reported by most international sources does so.  
* **Disputed or special‑status regions**: The Chinese figure includes Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macau (as listed by the Chinese government). The Russian figure includes the entire internationally recognized territory of the Russian Federation.

### Quick reference (numeric only)

- **China:** 9,596,961 km²  
- **France:** 643,801 km²  
- **Russia:** 17,098,242 km²  
- **United Kingdom:** 242,495 km²  
- **United States:** 9,833,517 km²  

These are the most widely‑cited, up‑to‑date area statistics for each P5 member as of 2025.
